column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4 hollow Earth and fallen angels
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Wh-what is this place!?
Th-the ground is stuck to the ceiling!?
The inside of this Earth is a gigantic hollow...
This is where the angels defeated by $$メフィスト$$'s forces in the $$創世記戦争$$
were confined beneath the earth—the prison of the white-$$羽$$ed angels!
Though by now they have completely lost their reason and gone feral...
this has become the hell of the $$堕天使$$s!!
H-hey!
They are eating their comrades' flesh!?
There is no other food here!
Moreover, since they were originally angels, they cannot easily die,
the victor deliberately devours only enough of the loser to leave them alive, then the fighting begins anew.
Even the one you saw being eaten will have regenerated by the time they awaken,
only to hunt another for food—an endless cycle of hell!!
That is... awful...
Everyone! Please stop!!
SKREEEE!! Hssssss!!
It is useless, $$マルコ$$!
They no longer possess any normal emotions...
No—their reaction now may be the true nature all angels were meant to have!
Any more attempts to speak with them will certainly lead to battle!!
Our objective is the $$天国の門$$ ahead!!
No need to linger here. We are leaving for it at once!!
